description: After expiry: settle(proof) through the account, only while the first round landed inside the lag. Other settlement paths are not agent actions: use prepare_settle from an ordinary wallet. Checks the account's limits, then returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the session key, simulated first. Above the approval threshold it returns EIP-712 typed data for the owner instead, which only works when the owner is an ordinary wallet: it refuses when the owner is a contract, such as a Safe. Never signs or sends.

approval.description: Only above the approval threshold: the nonce and deadline from typedData, plus the owner's signature

signature.description: The owner's EIP-712 signature over typedData

approvalTtlSeconds.description: Optional: how long a new approval stays valid. Default 1 hour

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

sessionKey.description: The session key that will send it (0x...). Not held by this server
